Name: UPDATED - Flowering Fields - More Grass Edition with New Flower Grass Options
Author: strangelyliteral
Description:
With the original flower grass now a config option for Starblue Valley, I created six new flower grass variations for spring, summer, and fall to use with the More Grass mod. Now each season has even more color and variety than before. Grass still uses my slightly shorter lengths, which makes hunting down missing chickens and truffles a breeze.

If you play with winter enabled, this will also show my snow flurries and berry grass for winter.

Recommend for use with Starblue Valley, as the grass colors coordinate with my mod.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI v3.3.2[/url]﻿﻿ (or later if available).
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download and unzip the files into your Stardew Valley > Mods folder.
[/list]
To uninstall, simply delete Flowering Fields from your Mods directory. No muss, no fuss.


[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Flowering Fields is a More Grass pack, so while it will override Content Patcher/XNB packs, it will not conflict with More Grass versions of other grass mods, such as Eemie's, Ali's, Lumisteria's, or DustBeauty's More Grass packs.
